t: A roomy FPGA board for building your own processors and network gadgets.
steps: Buy the Arty A7-100T from Digilent or DigiKey for about 300 US dollars.
Get a micro-USB cable to connect it to your computer.
Install the free edition of AMD Vivado. Plan for a large download.
Download the Arty A7 master constraint file from the Digilent XDC repo.
Write or copy a blinky design and build it in Vivado.
Program the board over USB and watch the LEDs blink.
Try the MicroBlaze tutorial next to run your first C program.
meta: Open Board. From $299. A few stores.
